issue_title: Removing multiple stacking estimators in one set_params call shifts later replacements
pr_title: Resolve named stacking replacements before removing estimators
issue_body:
### Description

The shared stacking parameter handler resolves names against the original estimator list but deletes entries immediately. A later named change then uses an index from before the deletion. Removing multiple estimators can raise IndexError, and mixing a removal with a replacement can silently replace the wrong estimator.

### Reproduction

```python
from sklearn.dummy import DummyRegressor
from sklearn.linear_model import Ridge
from sklearn.svm import SVR
from mlxtend.regressor import StackingRegressor

stack = StackingRegressor(
    regressors=[DummyRegressor(), Ridge(), SVR()],
    meta_regressor=Ridge(),
)
stack.set_params(dummyregressor=None, svr=None)
```

This raises `IndexError: list assignment index out of range` instead of retaining only Ridge. Reversing the keyword order succeeds. The same issue affects both ordinary and cross-validated stacking classifiers/regressors, and real GridSearchCV calls that remove more than one model.

### Proposed change and evidence

Resolve all named replacements against the original names first, then remove None entries together. Retain the existing root-replacement → named-replacement → nested-parameter order.

On unchanged source `1aee767ef57b84a8191511a08955c583b65de382`, the same 40 new regression/control cases report **24 failed, 16 passed**. With the fix, the four stacking suites, existing sequential-selector suite and new module report **180 passed, 1 skipped**.

Tests compare actual fitted predictions and grid-search fold scores with independently constructed stacks containing exactly the intended models. They cover both keyword orders, multiple removals, removal plus replacement, numbered duplicate estimator types, root-list replacement and nested parameters.

[Successful validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/mlxtend/actions/runs/43672533517).
pr_body:
### Description

Named estimator changes currently mutate list positions while still resolving later names against the original list. This makes a single `set_params` operation depend on keyword order: later removals/replacements can fail or target the wrong model.

Resolve all named changes using the original estimator names, then rebuild the list with None entries removed. Preserve root-list replacement before named changes and nested parameter updates afterward. The existing shared helper fixes all four stacking estimators.

### Validation

Base: `1aee767ef57b84a8191511a08955c583b65de382`. Validated source: `2aac2afe30499cb7d3ebd25f3e047d770d8233fd`.

- Same 40 new regression/control cases on unchanged production source: **24 failed, 16 passed**.
- Four existing stacking suites, the sequential-selector suite that also uses the shared helper, and the new module: **180 passed, 1 skipped**, with 24 warnings.
- Real public fitting and held-out-point predictions compared with independently constructed intended stacks.
- Real GridSearchCV fold scores, best hyperparameters and final predictions compared with grids over explicitly retained models.
- Multiple removals; removal plus middle/last replacement; both keyword orders; duplicate estimator types with numbered names; root-list replacement; nested parameters on the surviving estimator.
- Black, isort and Flake8 pass on both changed Python files; checkout remains clean after validation.
- Python 3.11.18, NumPy 2.4.0, SciPy 1.16.3, scikit-learn 1.8.0, frozen uv dependencies on Ubuntu. The full repository suite was not run.

[Successful exact-commit validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/mlxtend/actions/runs/43672533517).

### Related work

Reviewed all-state estimator-replacement/removal history and actual #515 and #522 diffs. #515 introduced this helper and explicitly tested removal with None, but only one named removal at a time. All 34 pre-existing fork heads retain the original index-shifting implementation.

This patch fixes the existing shared stacking helper. It is independent of the separate voting-classifier patch that replaces stale cached mappings and delegates named replacement to this helper.

### Pull Request Checklist

- [x] Added a changelog entry.
- [x] Added public fitting and grid-search regressions across all four stacking estimators.
- [x] Preserved root/named/nested parameter ordering.
- [x] Relevant tests and changed-file style checks pass.
